messages.subject: Re: Related to behThreshold
messages.body_plain:
Hi, If your objective function is NSE, it means that greater NSE is better, so if you set the behavioral threshold is x, all simulation that has NSE > x will be used to derive the p and r-factor for the 95PPU.
